expectations.text: Separates event (past-tense verb on webhook) from status (persistent state) from issue (why / what to do)
expectations.evidence: Three-carrier split present: event order.payment_failed, status order.pending.payment, issue.

expectations.text: Names states for the present condition, NOT the obligation/next step — does not recommend pending or requires_* as status names
expectations.evidence: Recommends order.pending.payment and explicitly states 'Name states by what's needed next, not by where they sit in the lifecycle. pending.payment tells the consumer a payment is owed' — the reversed (old) advice.

expectations.text: Says failure should loop back to a recoverable state rather than a terminal payment_failed
expectations.evidence: Self-loop on pending_payment; no terminal payment_failed.

expectations.text: Recommends a dot-separated {domain}.{state} parseable string and discusses the enum-vs-string trade-off
expectations.evidence: Enum-vs-string section, prefix matching, decide once for status and issue codes.
